title: Wire a runtime consumer for awardXp and grantMilestone
description: awardXp and grantMilestone (packages/core/src/state/domainMutations.ts) are the policy-guarded, atomic XP and milestone award operations, but no tool or CLI path calls them (only tests); getLevelUpEligibility is consumed by packages/cli/src/playProgression.ts and guidedLevelUpFlow. The capability inventory (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12.6) records both awards as retained and staged. This bead owns deciding how awards reach play (model tool, CLI command, or both) or demoting them. Found while re-deriving the inventory.
